banner.title: radarr
banner.tagline: Tracks wanted movies, grabs Usenet releases through Prowlarr and SABnzbd, and imports the finished files into the NAS library.

explainer.title: From a wanted movie to a file in the library

steps.title: State
steps.text: The init-db container makes sure the radarr database and role exist on shared postgres-18-rw. Radarr keeps its settings in the radarr-config claim.
steps.scene: a stack of database cylinders with a small key

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Radarr asks the indexers that Prowlarr provides for each wanted movie, then ranks the releases by the Recyclarr scores.
steps.scene: a magnifying glass over a row of release cards

steps.title: Grab
steps.text: The chosen NZB goes to SABnzbd, which downloads and repairs it on shared-downloads.
steps.scene: a download arrow dropping a folder into a tray

steps.title: Import
steps.text: Radarr copies the finished file from /data/downloads into /data/nas-media. NFS and CephFS cannot hardlink, so every import is a copy.
steps.scene: a file being copied onto a library shelf

steps.title: Back up
steps.text: kopiur snapshots radarr-config to Ceph every four hours and to R2 at 11:00 New York time, daily.
steps.scene: a shield over a cube and a cloud
